Just to help people understand some French satire a bit better, I'm not French myself, from what I understand (and what I would expect both from French stereotypes and the satire I experience in Denmark), a core aspect of French satire is basically going full-blown Poe's law. The image or text is very vocal about it's "support" of a certain issue, but the support is rendered in an absurdist way that anyone who isn't a retard would find hurts the case more than it helps it. Basically, in satire and politics you are very much expected to laugh at people who act like clowns in order to "help" a particular cause.

Basically, from what I understand Colbert is quite unique in the US, but in continental Europe, he would still be exceptionally skilled at comedy, but his form or type of comedy would run of the mill.
